entry.name: showDate
entry.label: Show the date below the time

entry.name: dateFormat
entry.label: Date format: short, isoDate, longDate or custom

entry.name: customDateFormat
entry.label: Custom date format string used when dateFormat is custom

entry.name: showDayOfWeek
entry.label: Prepend the abbreviated day of week to the date

entry.name: showWeekNumbers
entry.label: Show week numbers in the calendar

entry.name: notificationLimit
entry.label: Maximum number of notifications shown in the popup

entry.name: showNotificationHistory
entry.label: Show notification history: keep expired and dismissed notifications in the list

entry.name: showNotificationJobs
entry.label: Show jobs (file transfers, downloads) in the notification list

entry.name: showDoNotDisturb
entry.label: Show the Do Not Disturb switch at the bottom of the popup

entry.name: timeFontSizePt
entry.label: Font size of the time in points; 0 means automatic

entry.name: dateFontSizePt
entry.label: Font size of the date in points; 0 means automatic

entry.name: textAlignment
entry.label: Alignment of the clock inside the applet: 0 = right (like Windows 11), 1 = center, 2 = left

entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Font family; empty means the Plasma theme font

entry.name: useCustomTextColor
entry.label: Use a custom color for the time and date

entry.name: textColor
entry.label: Custom color of the time and date
